selector.rationale: Positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold and persistent distal ileitis despite antibiotic treatment support intestinal tuberculosis, while Crohn's disease is also possible due to ileocolonoscopy findings, but the presence of latent TB and response to isoniazid initiation leans towards intestinal tuberculosis

rejected.label: Helminth infection
